name: Land of the Sighted (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a land of diviners that use their gift of sight to find their foe’s weaknesses and the best routes towards leading their people.

Imperial Training: claw blade

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes a penalty to saving throws equal to 1/4 your emissary level (minimum -1).

Imperial Origin Abilities
Insightful Vision (Su)

At 1st level, you can glimpse into the future and gain knowledge on how to best leverage your actions. As a swift action you can grant yourself a bonus equal to 1/2 your class level (minimum +1) on the next Charisma-based skill check, including for feinting, or the next Acrobatics check you make. The check must be made before the beginning of your next turn and the ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Spring of Sight (Su)

At 7th level, you allow your visions of magic to aid your allies. As a standard action, you can emit an aura that grants all allies within 15 feet a competence bonus to their spell attack rolls and spell save DCs equal to 1/5 your class level. You can maintain this aura as a swift action and the aura lasts for a number of rounds per day equal to your class level. The rounds need not be consecutive.

Visionary’s Exploit (Su)

At 14th level, as an immediate action usable when you empire’s mark or overcharged mark is discharged, you may apply your empire’s mark or overcharged mark against the same target. This is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.
